name: Feature Engineering
overview: This python program, written in a series of steps, was used to demonstrate feature engineering using git branches and basic data science practices using the Pandas package.
details: The python program first reads in an excel file with clothing store inventory data on multiple tabs - a common format encountered in the federal government - using Pandas, and then counts rows and columns per tab. This program is committed to the main branch. Three separate feature engineering branches (inventory_analysis_branch1, ...2, ..3) were then created in the command line. In each of these branches, a separate analysis was conducted. The first feature (inventory_analysis_feature1) added calculated values to the dataframes. This feature was then accepted and merged into the main branch. Additional work was done with the main branch to create summary statistics using the calculated values. Then features 2 and 3 were merged to the main branch. Feature 2 (inventory_analysis_feature2) calculated summary statistics based on the category of clothing. Feature 3 (inventory_analysis_feature3) stacked (via rows) the datasets together.
